4. The above stated Other Class Suits were heard analogously and disposed of by a common judgment dated 3-2-1997. The learned Subordinate Judge decreed Other Class Suit No. 5 of 1997 and dismissed Other Class Suit Nos. 6 of 1997 and 7 of 1997. 

 6. The appeal was sent to the Second Court of Additional District Judge, Bogra for disposal. In the appeal the appellant-opposite party No. 1 filed an application under the provisions of Order 6, rule 17 read with sections 153 and 107(2) of the Code of Civil Procedure for amendment of the plaint. The amendments sought were that (i) For a decree of mandatory injunction directing the defendant Nos. 11 to 18 to reinstate him to the Office of thePrincipal of the College with all the back salaries and allowances allowable under the law, (ii) For adding 7 persons and, the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh as defendants in the suit.
